scope: Core command assessment and per-tick immutable read snapshots only. Public input/output state validation, admission revalidation, atomic rollback, fee comparison, resource boundaries and domain ordering remain in place.

method.timings: Indicative pure Node timings on a shared machine; these are neither browser input latency nor DOM/layout time. Whole-state clone counts are deterministic. Total clone-call count can increase because reusable snapshots copy smaller pieces.

catalogBuilds.normalization: None. Both passes import the exact preserved source snapshots, including the captured opening save. Existing saved build provenance remains unchanged.

safety.cacheLifetime: Private to one advanceWeek invocation; there is no cross-operation mutable-state trust cache.
safety.durableSlices: Frozen plain-data copies are reused only while the engine-owned slice replacement identity is unchanged. applyResult still clones each installed owned slice.
safety.coordinator: Queue, receipts, random streams, journal, schedules and remaining top-level data are cloned fresh on every handler read.
safety.exoticFallback: Recursively non-plain Map/Set/Date-containing values receive fresh copies; Object.freeze is not used as proof of immutable internals. The same rule separates command validation and quoting for these values.
safety.independentReview: The exotic-value isolation finding was fixed conservatively; bounded follow-up review found no additional concrete P1/P2 in the snapshot/assessment paths.

suites.note: All33 W0 identities passed on the final production core. The separate W25-P10 failure in this mixed log is resolved by the final planning log; no W0 rerun was needed.

initialExpectationCorrection.cause: The old expectation assigned Studio to every revenue-earning imported company. The preserved Wave16 W537 fixture already has its own active facility-wave8-scale-command-3, so the Wave28 room selector correctly returns Campus. Only the expected room table was corrected; fixture data and application selector were unchanged.
